r01.rule: collector name is the line's region

r02.rule: header line is not a record

r04.rule: month window in UTC, end exclusive

r05.rule: rating order ties broken by record_id

r06.rule: plan and segment in force at the line's timestamp

r07.rule: credit base = lines of committed accounts of accounts.csv (LV-MU-3, noise)

r08.rule: credit pool is the region's own pool

r09.rule: minimum is the region's pool minimum

r12.rule: same input gives the same output

r14.rule: missing input exits non-zero naming the file

r16.rule: surrounding spaces trimmed from every text field

r19.rule: north units JSON integer only (LV-MU-1, noise)

r22.rule: text units are ASCII digits only

r23.rule: account ids upper-cased with hyphens removed (LV-MU-4, noise)

r26.rule: product names matched on the collector's own key only

r30.rule: control mismatch exits non-zero naming the file

r31.rule: duplicates dropped before any other check

r32.rule: check order gives the quarantine reason

r33.rule: change effective at its own timestamp, inclusive

r34.rule: fields a change does not name keep their value

r36.rule: tier counter counts earlier lines in all collectors

r37.rule: tier counter shared by the billing group

r38.rule: billing group follows the parent column to its end (LV-MU-5)

r39.rule: parent column read in canonical id form

r40.rule: tier from earlier lines only, whole line one tier

r41.rule: unit rate for the segment in force

r43.rule: totals are sums of rounded line charges

r44.rule: base at or below the pool: each counted line gets its own charge

r45.rule: credit and true-up shares exact, rounded half-even

r47.rule: every cent of the pool shared again over the lines that held 0.50 (LV-MU-6)

r49.rule: true-up only when the credit base is below the minimum

r51.rule: every cent of the shortfall shared again over the lines that held 0.50 (LV-MU-7)

r52.rule: true-up only on lines counted in the credit base

r53.rule: net = charge minus credit plus true-up

r54.rule: credit totals are sums of line credits

r63.rule: segment documents use the segment in force
